confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge; no menus, listings, or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and coffee anchors are moderately grounded. Accommodation anchors carry the widest uncertainty because rates vary by neighborhood, booking channel, and season. Cocktail and wine_glass were anchored to the local beer relationship (cocktail about 2x draft beer; wine glass about 1.2x beer) because direct knowledge is weaker. July is Chilean winter, so accommodation assumes off-peak to shoulder-season rates. Meal anchors are menu-price estimates that exclude the customary 10% propina.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional Latin American basis: Santiago is treated as an upper-middle-income South American capital, priced above typical Lima and Bogotá restaurant and hotel levels and below Western European capitals. No named comparable listings were consulted.
